population: every tracked *.py under core/, dialogs/, tabs/, ui/, config/ plus app.py, main_window.py, run.py, reset_database.py (187-188 files as modules are added); unimported files count as 0%
metric: branch+line: (covered lines + covered branches) / (statements + branches), coverage 7.16.2

margin: 0.13 percentage point below the lowest of three CI measurements and 0.90 below the latest, so the floor never equals a single run and line/branch jitter does not trip it
policy: non-decreasing. Raise only to a value actually measured by the CI coverage leg (see the 'coverage' notice annotation); never lower it to pass, never add omit patterns that hide product code (tests/test_coverage_floor_gate.py).
